name: VIX-spike capitulation inside an intact macro regime arms BB-z washout (buy-the-fear)
rationale: THESIS: the most reliable reversion is fear WITHOUT a regime break — a vix_level SPIKE (gt a fitted panic floor) that coincides with macro_regime STILL risk-on (gt) signals a sentiment flush rather than a structural de-risking, and crypto majors snap back. The dual gate is deliberately CONTRADICTORY-looking (high vix AND intact macro) to isolate transient panic from regime change. bb_z washout is the price trigger. DISCONFIRMER 1 (is the macro-intact condition load-bearing, or just buy-high-vix?): a sibling that drops the macro_regime>floor condition (buy any vix spike) should be WORSE precisely in the episodes where vol spiked BECAUSE the macro regime broke; if it is equal/better, the macro gate is decoration. DISCONFIRMER 2 (is it just the washout?): bare bb_z washout control (inbox) is the floor. DISCONFIRMER 3 (level-in-disguise?): the vix panic floor is fitted, not magic; the holdout slice with a frozen param must hold or the level was overfit to one cycle's vol scale.
catalyst: vix_level spikes above a fitted panic floor WHILE macro_regime remains risk-on, with a bb_z washout
